{{Quote|The Nebula Front may have laudable goals, but their methods are ruthless.|Oppo Rancisis|<ref name="COD" />}}
The '''Nebula Front''' was a radical [[Politics/Legends|political]] group opposed to the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and other vast corporate conglomerates. The group was headquartered on [[Asmeru/Legends|Asmeru]] with members from along the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]]&mdash;particularly from [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Its emblem was a blue line with arrows on each end.

==History==
The Nebula Front organization could have been described&mdash;depending on one's point of view&mdash;as terrorists or freedom fighters. Its membership mainly comprised beings living along the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]], especially from its [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] end&mdash;and at least several among the Front's leadership had been involved in the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]]. Headquartered on [[Asmeru/Legends|Asmeru]], many of the Front's leaders&mdash;especially those of its the militant wing&mdash;were referred to as "[[Havac]]."

The Front was an organization opposing the de facto monopolies and government control exercised by large corporate conglomerates along the Outer Rim, most notably the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. The Front's view of the complacent [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] was scarcely, if at all, better. As such, numerous oppressed beings chafing under harsh conditions imposed by the Federation and its crony governments and corporations viewed the Front with sympathy or clandestine support.

Said governments and corporations were somewhat less tolerant of the Front's actions, so any progress it made was limited. However, no matter how hopeless their cause seemed, the Front refused to deal with any organizations that were involved with [[Spice/Legends|spice]] smuggling or [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]], and always attempted to maintain their disruptions as peaceful acts of civil disobedience.

At one point a [[Finis Valorum's father|member]] of the [[House Valorum/Legends|Valorum]] [[Politics/Legends|political]] dynasty had an opportunity to destroy the Nebula Front, but only chastised them, an act [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] considered ironic given the ramifications it had on his [[Reproduction/Legends|son's]] term as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]].<ref name="COD" />

The failure of such acts and noble paths to make any effect led, in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], to the development of a militant wing led by two of the Front's leaders, [[Eru Matalis]] and [[Cindar]]. They contracted noted [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] mercenary [[Arwen Cohl]] to attack a Trade Federation ship. The subsequent [[Dorvalla Incident]] was the first major victory of the Front, providing them not only with much publicity, but also enough stolen [[Aurodium/Legends|aurodium]] to fund an attempted assassination of Supreme Chancellor [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]].<ref name="COD" />

Unfortunately for them, it also attracted the notice of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], who sent [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in response (both happened to be present at Dorvalla). Although the two were unable to prevent the Front's assassination of the [[Trade Federation Directorate]] at the [[Eriadu Trade Summit]], they killed or arrested the Front's leaders, thus essentially crippling the organization.<ref name="COD" />

However, following the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the organization kidnapped [[Shella Motti]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Nebula Front was represented by a miniature in the ''[[Scum & Villainy]]'' expansion of the ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]''. The squadrons represented by miniatures labeled "Nebula Front" and "Nebula Elite" established the insignia of the organization with the blue arrow markings on the units' wings.<ref name="SWPM">{{PocketModel|set=Scum & Villainy|cardname=Nebula Front Z-95 Headhunter|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/shipsv09c.jpg}}</ref>
